idea-plugin.name: JAVA_HOME SDK Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Synchronize your Project SDK with the JAVA_HOME environment variable on project startup.

Features:

  • Shows a notification on project startup to sync the Project SDK with JAVA_HOME
  • One-click synchronization via the notification
  • Automatically creates and registers the JDK in IntelliJ if not already present
  • Updates Language Level to match the SDK version
  • Manual sync action available in Tools menu
  • Perfect for teams using tools like direnv, nix, devbox, or asdf to manage JAVA_HOME per project

Usage:

  • On project open: A notification appears with "Sync Now" button to synchronize
  • Manual: Use Tools → Sync SDK from JAVA_HOME to manually trigger synchronization at any time
